metadata.title: Exact Verification and Reproducibility Package for "Minimum Bell-Setting Complexity for Qubit POVM–PVM Separation"
metadata.description:
This record archives the exact verification and reproducibility package accompanying the preprint “Minimum Bell-Setting Complexity for Qubit POVM–PVM Separation.”

The package includes:

  • exact rational Bell-coefficient tables;
  • exact qubit states and POVM strategies;
  • symbolic verification of the 3×23\times23×2 separation certificate;
  • symbolic checks of the Lorentz metric, null-ray map, exceptional fibers, and incidence second-variation identities;
  • an exact rank-zero deterministic simulator;
  • the complete manuscript source and rendered PDFs;
  • proof, dependency, literature-priority, equivalence, and risk audits;
  • a theorem-to-artifact map and focused expert-review packet;
  • a one-command offline verification runner.

Reference environment: Python 3.14.6 and SymPy 1.14.0. The manuscript PDFs build with Tectonic 0.16.9.

The executable checks verify finite exact algebraic identities and explicit constructions. They do not constitute formal verification of the universal convexity, extremality, physical-reconstruction, or rank-exhaustion arguments, which are supplied as mathematical proofs in the associated manuscript.

Associated preprint DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21699161

Immutable source tag: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/main/qubit_povm_pvm_minimum_settings/submission/zenodo-v1.1.0

Generative-AI systems were used substantively throughout the research and software-development workflow. The human author accepts responsibility for the released package.
